# appgatesdp_authorization (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `crl_enabled` (Boolean) Whether X509 CRL is enabled for the system or not. Issued Certificates is disabled if it's not enabled.
- `expires` (String) Token expiration time.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `inactivity_timeout_enabled` (Boolean) Whether user session inactivity timeout is enabled or not. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `inactivity_timeout_minutes` (Number) Number of minutes of inactivity before a user session is terminated. Minimum value is 1 minute. Not applicable if inactivity timeout is disabled. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `message_of_the_day` (String) Message of the day configured by an admin.
- `pp_mode_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Protection Profile mode is enabled or not. Limits certain functionalities. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The AuthToken required for subsequent API calls.
- `user` (Attributes) Information about logged in user, such as username and email address, if exists. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))
- `ztp_account_type` (String) ZTP account type.
- `ztp_collective_type` (String) ZTP type of the collective.

<a id="nestedatt--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user`

Read-Only:

- `can_access_audit_logs` (Boolean) Whether there is a LogServer deployed and the user has privileges to access to it.
- `name` (String) Username.
- `need_two_factor_auth` (Boolean) If true, it is not possible to complete login process without providing MFA.
- `privileges` (Attributes List) The privileges the user has. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user--privileges))

<a id="nestedatt--user--privileges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user.privileges`

Read-Only:

- `default_tags` (List of String) The items in this list would be added automatically to the newly created objects' tags. Only applicable on "Create" type and targets with tagging capability. This field must be omitted if not applicable.
- `functions` (List of String) Privilege for changing Appliance Functions. Only applicable on "AssignFunction" type with Appliance or All target. This field must be omitted if not applicable.
- `scope` (Attributes) The scope of the Privilege. Only applicable to certain type-target combinations. Some types depend on the IdP/MFA type, such as GetUserAttributes. This field must be omitted if not applicable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user--privileges--scope))
- `target` (String) The target of the Privilege defines the possible target objects for that type.
- `type` (String) The type of the Privilege defines the possible administrator actions.

<a id="nestedatt--user--privileges--scope"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user.privileges.scope`

Read-Only:

- `all` (Boolean) 'If "true", all objects are accessible. For example, "type: Edit - target: Condition - scope.all: true" means the administrator can edit all Conditions in the system.'
- `ids` (List of String) Specific object IDs this Privilege would have access to.
- `tags` (List of String) Object tags this privilege would have access to.
